newsitem.title: USA: Rowan to build two offshore drilling rigs.
newsitem.headline: Rowan to build two offshore drilling rigs.

text.p: Rowan Cos Inc said Monday its directors had approved the construction of two mobile offshore drilling rigs.
The rigs, Gorilla VI and Gorilla VII, will essentially be identical to Gorilla V, which is currently under construction.
Gorilla VI and Gorilla VII will be capable of operating in the North Sea in water depths of up to 400 feet.
The rigs are estimated to cost $380 million and will be constructed at the Vicksburg, Miss., facility of the company's LeTourneau subsidiay.
Delivery is estimated for the first quarter of 1999 and the second quarter of 2000.
Rowan Chairman C.R. Palmer said, "Rowan is confident of a bright future for technologically superior drilling equipment operating in hostile marine environments."
